rows.comment:

rows.name: CUnit_GetSupportZ
rows.comment:
CUnit vtable slot e4. thiscall ECX unit, stack4 point*, stack8 layer (ECX of 78d1e0), stackC out on-deck flag*, stack10 force; RET10; x87 ST0. Flyer (Unit+5c&20000000, Unit+200<=0): e8 + base + (z(-3)-base)*e8/max210 (max>0.01). Else base (+water max if Unit+1fc&38, amph only with Unit+280&20) + e8. Live: Amrf hfoo 768->968 after SetUnitFlyHeight200, control hfoo stays 768; hover moveHeight50 adds 50. Evidence: research/BASE-02.1 (static asm, Unicorn oracle, live types2 captures).

Order: structure(68c190(1))&&Unit+280 bit8 -> 69a9d0; else base = bit8 ? (cached Unit+28c when !force && |dx|,|dy|<.001 && Unit+224 path unresolved, else 66b1b0 multi-sample average) : 78d1e0(layer); fly=vt+e8; if Unit+5c&20000000 && Unit+200<=0: return fly + base + (78d1e0(-3)-base)*fly/Unit+210 (if max>0.01, else unscaled); else if Unit+1fc&0x38 and water present and (Unit+1fc!=0x20 or Unit+280&0x20) and water>base: base=water; return fly+base. 8064-case original-code oracle 0 mismatches; live 5 movetypes x 8 file-backed points.
